author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Angel Martinez (foot) takes batting practice Saturday
desc: Angel Martinez took batting practice on Saturday.
impact: Martinez suffered a non-displaced fracture in his left foot on June 13. He resumed hitting off a tee in late June and has since progressed to batting practice. While he continues to make encouraging progress, fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to return until late July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dane Myers (shoulder) receives injection Saturday
desc: Dane Myers received an injection in his AC joint on Saturday.
impact: Myers suffered a left shoulder contusion on June 29 against the Milwaukee Brewers after crashing into the outfield wall while making a running catch. He received an injection in his AC joint on Saturday and is expected to rest for a few days before the Cincinnati Reds determine the next step in his recovery. He remains without a timetable for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Matt Shaw (hand) will not return before All-Star break
desc: Chicago Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Matt Shaw will not return before the All-Star break.
impact: Shaw has been sidelined since June 29 due to a left hand sprain. He's expected to be re-evaluated next week to determine next steps and receive a clearer timeline for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Shea Langeliers (thumb) hopeful to return Tuesday
desc: The Athletics are hopeful Shea Langeliers can return to the lineup for Tuesday's series opener against the Tigers.
impact: Langeliers suffered a left thumb contusion in Friday's game against the Marlins while receiving a pitch in the fifth inning and eventually exited the game in the fourth inning. It appears he'll avoid a stint on the injured list and could return to the lineup Tuesday after a few days off. While he's sidelined, Jonah Heim will continue to start behind the plate.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Shota Imanaga picks up loss Saturday
desc: Shota Imanaga allowed two runs on four hits and three walks while striking out eight across 4.2 innings in Saturday's 3-0 loss to the St. Louis Cardinals.
impact: Imanaga gave up a leadoff home run to JJ Wetherholt to start the game, but settled down and allowed just an RBI single in the third inning. He showcased his upside in this one, recording eight strikeouts,  his most since May 7, when he recorded 10 against the Cincinnati Reds. He owns a 4.28 ERA and 1.10 WHIP with 100 strikeouts in 103 innings this season. He'll look to deliver fantasy managers another solid outing on Friday against the Reds.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Sandy Alcantara fans eight hitters in win Saturday
desc: Sandy Alcantara allowed one run on six hits and one walk while striking out eight across eight innings in Saturday's 7-2 win over the Athletics.
impact: After walking five batters and giving up five runs in his previous start at Coors Field, Alcantara delivered a huge bounce-back performance, limiting the free passes and pitching eight innings on 100 pitches. The only run he gave up came in the seventh inning, after two singles set up a Jeff McNeil sacrifice fly. He owns a 4.00 ERA and 1.25 WHIP with 92 strikeouts across 123.2 innings this season. His next scheduled start is on Friday against the Cleveland Guardians.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kyle Stowers clears fence Saturday
desc: Kyle Stowers went 2-for-4 with a home run, a walk, two runs scored and two RBI in Saturday's 7-2 win over the Athletics.
impact: Stowers hit a 377-foot homer to left-center field in the seventh inning off right-hander Kade Morris. He's now homered three times over his last two games and owns an impressive .367/.441/.800 slash line over his last seven games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Joe Mack goes deep Saturday
desc: Joe Mack went 2-for-5 with a home run, one run scored and an RBI in Saturday's 7-2 win over the Athletics.
impact: Mack kicked off the scoring for the Marlins, hitting a solo homer off Aaron Civale in the third. The 23-year-old backstop has now homered in three of his last five games and has seven total on the year in 141 at-bats. He's posted a .255/.314/.440 slash line in 47 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez mashes homer Saturday
desc: Otto Lopez went 3-for-5 with a home run, a double, one run scored and three RBI in Saturday's 7-2 win over the Athletics.
impact: Lopez hit a 375-foot homer off Aaron Civale in the third inning and later added an RBI double in the fourth. He's now recorded multi-hit games in three straight contests while riding a five-game hitting streak, and he owns a league-leading .341 average on the year.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Liam Hicks records three hits Saturday
desc: Liam Hicks went 3-for-5 with two runs scored in Saturday's 7-2 win over the Athletics.
impact: Hicks returned from the injured list on June 30 from a low back strain and has been terrific, going 9-for-23 with two walks, eight runs scored and an RBI. While he's yet to record an extra-base hit, he continues to do his job by getting on base hitting at the top of the Marlins order. He owns a .288/.365/.465 slash line with 13 home runs in 78 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero hits 11th homer in 11 games
desc: Junior Caminero went 2-for-4 with a home run, a walk, two runs scored, one RBI and a stolen base in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: Caminero stayed red hot on Saturday, crushing a 437-foot home run off Hunter Brown in the first inning to extend his remarkable power surge to 11 home runs over his last 11 games. He also reached base two other times and chipped in his first stolen base of the season, providing fantasy managers with production across the board. The 23-year-old continues to enjoy an impressive campaign, slashing .291/.379/.566 with 26 home runs.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Richie Palacios goes yard Saturday
desc: Richie Palacios went 2-for-4 with a home run, a walk, one run scored, two RBI and a stolen base in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: Palacios connected on a 409-foot home run off Hunter Brown in the second inning and later stole second base after singling in the seventh. After struggling to a .190/.261/.270 slash line in June, he's off to a solid start in July, going 3-for-11 with one home run, two runs scored and three RBI.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jonny DeLuca hits dinger Saturday
desc: Jonny DeLuca went 2-for-5 with a home run, one run scored, two RBI and two stolen bases in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: DeLuca turned in an impressive performance on Saturday, launching a 355-foot home run off Cristian Javier in the seventh inning while adding two stolen bases. He's been productive over his last seven games, slashing .238/.360/.429 with one home run, three runs scored, three RBI and two stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Victor Mesa Jr. steals base Saturday
desc: Victor Mesa Jr. went 0-for-2 with two walks, one run scored and a stolen base in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: While Mesa extended his hitless streak to three games, he still found a way to contribute by drawing two walks and scoring a run in the second inning. Despite seeing more consistent playing time, he remains off the fantasy radar, as he's slashing just .176/.279/.311 across 27 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cedric Mullins II swipes bag Saturday
desc: Cedric Mullins II went 1-for-3 with two walks, one run scored and a stolen base in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: Mullins has been one of the Tampa Bay Rays' hottest hitters of late, recording a hit in eight of his last nine games while collecting four home runs and two stolen bases during that span. He's becoming an increasingly appealing waiver wire option given his recent production, especially after batting third and fourth in the lineup in each of his last two starts.
